entities.name: EPSP synthase
observations: The 418-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt protein Q4ZY26 from Pseudomonas syringae pv. syringae.
Catalyzes transfer of the enolpyruvyl moiety from phosphoenolpyruvate to shikimate-3-phosphate.
Annotated as a cytoplasmic monomer; EC 2.5.1.19.
Contains Pfam EPSP_synthase domain PF00275.26 spanning residues 15–409.
Reference annotation identifies an active-site proton acceptor at position 297 and ligand-binding residues including positions 26–31, 97, 125, 170–172, 320, and 324.
Sequence-derived properties: 418 aa, approximately 43.55 kDa, theoretical pI 4.99, predicted charge at pH 7 of about -10.2, instability index 28.5.

entities.name: EPSP synthase reaction
observations: 3-phosphoshikimate + phosphoenolpyruvate yields 5-O-(1-carboxyvinyl)-3-phosphoshikimate plus phosphate; mapped to Rhea RHEA:21256 and EC 2.5.1.19.

entities.name: Chorismate biosynthesis
observations: EPSP synthase performs step 6 of 7 in chorismate biosynthesis from D-erythrose 4-phosphate and phosphoenolpyruvate, contributing to aromatic amino acid biosynthesis.

entities.name: EPSP synthase sequence properties
observations: Length 418 aa; molecular weight approximately 43,545 Da; theoretical pI 4.991; predicted charge at pH 7 approximately -10.15; instability index 28.538; GRAVY 0.1945.
